say:1:1820522001:0.text: You always pull a sword on people you just met? You're impossible!
say:1:1820522001:0.source_cn: 你……你真是个怪人！一言不合就挥剑！

say:2:1820522002:0.text: Impossible? Right back at you. Only Baden would know how to counter every move I make.
say:2:1820522002:0.source_cn: 更奇怪的人是你。不肯承认你就是巴登，却牢牢记得如何破解...

say:3:1820522003:0.text: Even though you've lost your memory, your body still remembers everything.
say:3:1820522003:0.source_cn: 即使你失忆了，你的身体和你的剑，却依然记得这一切。

say:5:1820522005:0.text: You're protecting Baba Muriel because she saved your life, right?
say:5:1820522005:0.source_cn: 你想保护穆婆婆，是因为她对你有救命之恩，对吗？

say:7:1820522007:0.text: Baba Muriel has saved my life more than once. It's only right that I repay her kindness.
say:7:1820522007:0.source_cn: 是，你是说的没错。是穆婆婆救了我，而且不止一次，所以我...

say:8:1820522008:0.text: Let me tell you a story. Back when we first joined the army, there was a farmer who regularly delivered food to our camp. One day, the Bantus army overran his village, but our commanding officer ordered us to fall back.
say:8:1820522008:0.source_cn: 我们刚入伍时，曾有一家农户来驻扎地给我们送粮食。后来，...

say:9:1820522009:0.text: And what did you do? You got into a heated argument with him, then marched off in defiance of his orders.
say:9:1820522009:0.source_cn: ——于是你违抗了军令，和长官大吵一架，扬长而去。

say:10:1820522010:0.text: Together, we slipped into the village and found the farmer's wife and child. We carried them out under a hail of enemy arrows. You took one to the shoulder that day, and the scar has stayed with you ever since.
say:10:1820522010:0.source_cn: 后来我们闯入敌军禁区，找到了幸存的女主人和她的孩子，背...

say:11:1820522011:0.text: H-How do you know about my scar...

say:12:1820522012:0.text: Back at camp, the medic said you'd have lost the arm if we'd been any later. But you just smiled and said it was a small price for saving two lives.
say:12:1820522012:0.source_cn: 回来包扎时，军医说再晚一会，你的胳膊就保不住了。但你只...

say:13:1820522013:0.text: From that day on, I made sure I was always with you whenever you did something reckless.
say:13:1820522013:0.source_cn: 这就是为什么你每次干傻事，我都要跟着你。

say:14:1820522014:0.text: Because I knew you'd never abandon someone in need, even if it meant risking your own life.
say:14:1820522014:0.source_cn: ——因为你永远不会放弃需要帮助的人，哪怕要搭上你自己的性命。

say:16:1820522015:0.text: That's right. You found a place for the two survivors in a village near our... home. The farmer's kid is now training under the local blacksmith.
say:16:1820522015:0.source_cn: 是的，你后来把这两位幸存者安置到了领……安置到了我们家...

say:17:1820522016:0.text: You barely knew <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yet you didn't hesitate to help him.
say:17:1820522016:0.male: You barely knew <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yet you didn't hesitate to help him.
say:17:1820522016:0.female: You barely knew <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yet you didn't hesitate to help her.

say:18:1820522017:1.text: And when Estrilda was dying, you went the extra mile to fulfill her last wish.
say:18:1820522017:1.source_cn: 你竭力想要减轻爱丝临终前的痛苦，只希望她能不留遗憾，哪...

say:19:1820522018:1.text: And when Estrilda was dying, you went the extra mile to fulfill her last wish.
say:19:1820522018:1.source_cn: 这些都是你身为巴登时就会做的事情。而你从很久以前，就从...

say:20:1820522019:1.text: Think it over, and you'll soon realize you're Baden.
say:20:1820522019:1.source_cn: 言尽于此。你自己想想吧。

say:22:1820522021:1.text: Estrilda, please take him with you. I'd rather not see him right now.
say:22:1820522021:1.source_cn: 爱丝，带他离开。我暂时不想看到他。

say:24:1820522022:1.text: Alright... I know you need to blow off some steam.

say:25:1820522023:1.text: Rain, want to take a walk in the woods? I've got a few more ideas I want to try!
say:25:1820522023:1.source_cn: 里纳，我们去附近的树林里逛逛吧？我还有一些办法想试试看...
